result.instructions: Tools for eventOne, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which events does my organization have coming up in the next three months?"; "List the sessions and speakers of our main conference."; "How many registration orders were completed this week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes eventOne data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run eventone_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run eventone_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run eventone_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. eventone_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: eventone_get_me
tools.title: Get my account
tools.description: Return the signed-in eventOne user (id, name, email, company). Good first call to confirm the token works.

tools.name: eventone_list_orgs
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the token can access, with their slugs. Use a slug in the other tools.

tools.name: eventone_get_org
tools.title: Get an organization
tools.description: Get one organization by id or by slug (give one of them).

tools.name: eventone_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events of one organization (by slug), with dates, publish state and type. Optional start-date window.

starts_after.description: Only events starting on or after this date.

starts_before.description: Only events starting on or before this date.

tools.name: eventone_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Get one event by id, or by event slug together with its organization slug.

tools.name: eventone_search_events
tools.title: Search events
tools.description: Search events by text across the platform. Returns matching events with their ids.

text.description: Search text, e.g. a city or an event name.

tools.name: eventone_list_days
tools.title: List event days
tools.description: List the days of an event's programme.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_timeslots
tools.title: List timeslots
tools.description: List the timeslots of an event's programme (start and end times per day).

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions
tools.description: List the sessions of an event: name, description, times, room, speakers and tracks.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_speakers
tools.title: List speakers
tools.description: List the speakers of an event with their titles, bios and featured flags.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_tracks
tools.title: List tracks
tools.description: List the tracks (session streams with colours) of an event.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_rooms
tools.title: List rooms
tools.description: List the rooms of an event with their building, capacity and map position.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_exhibitors
tools.title: List exhibitors and sponsors
tools.description: List the exhibitors and sponsors of an event. Filter with sponsors: INCLUDE, EXCLUDE or ONLY.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_forms
tools.title: List registration forms
tools.description: List the registration and survey forms of an event (names and types; not the answers).

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_promos
tools.title: List promo codes
tools.description: List the promo codes of an event with discount, status, limit and expiry.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_registration_orders
tools.title: List registration orders
tools.description: List the registration orders of an event, one page at a time. Contains attendee personal data. Filter by status (draft, pending, rejected, complete, refunded) or created date range.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

created_after.description: Only orders created on or after this date.

created_before.description: Only orders created on or before this date.

search_text.description: Free text search over the orders.

tools.name: eventone_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List the tickets of an event, or only those of one order. Contains attendee names and emails.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

order_id.description: Only tickets of this registration order.

tools.name: eventone_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List the people (contacts) of an organization, one page at a time, with an optional search. Contains personal data.

first.description: Number of people to return (default 25, max 100).

after.description: Cursor from endCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: eventone_get_event_attendance
tools.title: Get session attendance
tools.description: Get the recorded headcount for each session of an event.

event_id.description: The event id (from eventone_list_events or eventone_search_events).

tools.name: eventone_list_messages
tools.title: List push messages
tools.description: List the push notification messages of an organization, optionally for one event or channel. Read only.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with eventOne
prompts.description: What you can do with eventOne here, with example requests to try.
